'''I7-S7''' was an [[Astromech droid/Legends|Astromech droid]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] active in the aftermath of the [[war against Zakuul]]. In [[3630 BBY]] it was brought to [[Iokath]] to provide assistance during the the [[War on Iokath]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
I7-S7 appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' as a vendor on Iokath for Imperial-affiliated players.<ref name="SWTOR" />
